visual_goal: Show Part IV's eleven chapters as four stages: decide well, plan the journey, keep the estate healthy, organize and look ahead, ending in a coherent estate.
prompt: A left-to-right path of four milestones joined by arrows. First: a gavel on a table, labeled 'Decide well', with a stack of two books. Second: a folded map with a dotted route, labeled 'Plan the journey', with a stack of three books. Third: a heart-rate line over a shield, labeled 'Keep it healthy', with a stack of three books. Fourth: a telescope next to a simple team of three unlabeled figures, labeled 'Look ahead', with a stack of three books. One arrow from each milestone to the next. At the far right a compass labeled 'A coherent estate', with one arrow into it. Exactly four arrows.
alt: Four milestones: decide well, plan the journey, keep the estate healthy and look ahead, ending at a compass for a coherent estate.
